records.funder: Shenzhen MIIT Bureau (深圳市工业和信息化局)
records.instrument: 软件产业高质量发展项目: 重大开源项目 商业发行版软件推广
records.note: Guide 2024 (A): 30% of audited sales (actual receipts) of the commercial distribution and services in the prior year, within the annual budget; sales ≥5M yuan; distro must be certified by the upstream community; government-funded projects excluded. Press reports a 10M cap (C; cap line not in the guide text extracted). Guide definition (A): 重大开源项目 = project donated to OpenAtom by a Shenzhen company or subsidiary; terminal OS needs >300M devices; server OS needs the donor in the Linux kernel changeset top list for every kernel release of the past year; others need city-government approval (in practice OpenHarmony and openEuler, both Huawei-donated: inference).
records.selection: open-call (annual guide), competitive-review, 受专项资金年度预算总额控制
records.conditions: Shenzhen software firm selling commercial distribution of a major open-source project; rate on audited sales
records.intermediary: local bureau (深圳市工业和信息化局)
records.outputs_required: commercial sales (subsidy base); no upstream requirement reported

records.note: Guide 2024 (A): per-device baseline 10 yuan (128KB–1MB RAM), 40 yuan (1–128MB), 150 yuan (≥128MB); paid at 50%/40%/30% of baseline in years 1–3; phones and tablets excluded; device must be certified by the OS community; module purchases ≥1M yuan at baseline. No total budget published. Guide definition (A): 重大开源项目 = project donated to OpenAtom by a Shenzhen company or subsidiary; terminal OS needs >300M devices; server OS needs the donor in the Linux kernel changeset top list for every kernel release of the past year; others need city-government approval (in practice OpenHarmony and openEuler, both Huawei-donated: inference).
records.conditions: terminal makers buying open-source-OS (OpenHarmony) chip modules
records.intermediary: local bureau (深圳市工业和信息化局)
